children: Long.xyz said tokenized stock trading volume on the Robinhood Chain has surpassed $1 billion, marking a new milestone. According to ChainCatcher, since the Robinhood Chain launched, it has accounted for 15% of total tokenized stock DEX trading volume.
Long.xyz also said that although the Robinhood Chain's TVL has increased tenfold, Long.xyz still represents 10% of the chain's total tokenized stock TVL.

title: Long.xyz Says Robinhood Chain Tokenized Stock Trading Volume Tops $1 Billion
